recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-49797 unless BRR later selects different example codes or reopens the ResearchStudy.focus modeling decision.
issue_request: FHIR-49797 asked to keep ResearchStudy.focus as CodeableReference, replace the example binding value set with specific study-focus examples such as metformin, glucose monitoring, and cognitive behavioral therapy, and change the focus reference targets by removing EvidenceVariable while adding DeviceDefinition and PlanDefinition.
initial_application: The issue was applied through HL7/fhir PR #3335. Commit 2dbf13efbe changed ResearchStudy.focus target profiles, while a7f2d11240 and 6562ac0e53 replaced the local focus CodeSystem/value set content with SNOMED CT concepts and updated the binding/value-set descriptions.
additional_context: ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini, and the relevant StructureDefinition and ValueSet files are current build-scope source. BRR minutes on 2025-02-18 record retaining CodeableReference; 2025-02-25 minutes record the 11-0-0 vote for the requested value-set and target-profile updates. PR #3335 also included FHIR-49963, but that broader ResearchStudy cleanup was not independently reconciled here.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current focus element targets Medication, MedicinalProductDefinition, SubstanceDefinition, DeviceDefinition, and PlanDefinition, and the current Research Study Focus Type value set includes Metformin, Fasting blood glucose measurement, and Cognitive and behavioral therapy.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same PR and reused the ResearchStudy.focus example value set for ResearchStudy.keyword, but it covers broader ResearchStudy R6 cleanup and was not decided here.
